questions.route: Which one of the three routes is the safest usable route that accomplishes the mission, using only the stated facts?
questions.left_hazard: Does the LEFT route explicitly have a hazard or blockage?
questions.left_risk: How risky is the LEFT route based only on the description?
risk_criteria: Low risk: clearly safe and usable
Medium risk: uncertain safety or availability
High risk: explicitly hazardous or blocked

flooded_valley.title: 🌊 Flooded Valley
flooded_valley.goal: Cross the valley without entering floodwater or unsafe structures.
flooded_valley.story: Heavy rain has flooded the lower valley. Three marked routes are ahead.

paths.middle: Solid trail on high ground above the flood

flooded_valley.reason: The high-ground trail avoids both the weak bridge and floodwater.

space_station.title: 🛸 Space Station
space_station.goal: Reach the escape pod using a pressurized, passable corridor.
space_station.story: An alarm sounds. Station status panels show the following routes.

paths.middle: Pressurized corridor leading to the escape pod
paths.right: Passage blocked by a jammed emergency hatch

space_station.reason: Only the middle corridor is both pressurized and passable.

forest_evacuation.title: 🔥 Forest Evacuation
forest_evacuation.goal: Reach the evacuation point without entering an active hazard.
forest_evacuation.story: Smoke is spreading through the forest. Official route signs are visible.

paths.left: Path entering an active wildfire zone
paths.middle: Trail ending at a river with no crossing
paths.right: Open ranger-marked evacuation road to the shelter

forest_evacuation.reason: The marked evacuation road leads to shelter without a reported obstruction.

clockwork_castle.title: 🔑 Clockwork Castle
clockwork_castle.goal: Retrieve the key needed to open the final gate.
clockwork_castle.story: A sign reads: 'The key is hanging in the room with the brass clock.'

paths.left: Accessible room with a brass clock and a key hanging on the wall
paths.middle: Accessible room with an empty bookshelf
paths.right: Locked room with a stone statue

clockwork_castle.reason: The sign identifies the brass-clock room as the key's location.

mountain_descent.title: ⛰️ Mountain Descent
mountain_descent.goal: Get to the village safely before dark.
mountain_descent.story: The mountain weather is changing; your map marks one maintained descent.

paths.left: Cliffside ledge with an avalanche warning
paths.middle: Signed maintained descent trail leading to the village
paths.right: Steep unmarked ridge heading away from the village

mountain_descent.reason: The maintained trail is the signed route to the destination.

jungle_crossing.title: 🦜 Jungle Crossing
jungle_crossing.goal: Cross the river without taking an unnecessary water risk.
jungle_crossing.story: The river is swift. A notice board confirms the status of each crossing.

paths.left: Inspected footbridge marked OPEN and SAFE
paths.middle: Attempt to swim through strong rapids
paths.right: Small raft marked OUT OF SERVICE due to a leak

jungle_crossing.reason: The inspected and open footbridge is the safe crossing.

robot_workshop.title: 🤖 Robot Workshop
robot_workshop.goal: Reach the workshop exit while avoiding dangerous machinery.

paths.middle: Aisle beside exposed live electrical wiring
paths.right: Clear inspected aisle marked as the exit route

robot_workshop.reason: The clear inspected exit aisle avoids the blocked and electrical-hazard routes.

volcano_base.title: 🌋 Volcano Research Base
volcano_base.goal: Reach the observation shelter without crossing a danger zone.
volcano_base.story: A volcanic activity bulletin lists route conditions.

paths.left: Protected tunnel directly to the observation shelter
paths.middle: Trail across an active lava-flow exclusion zone

volcano_base.reason: The protected tunnel reaches the shelter without the stated hazards.
